# Straya Studio | Boutique Web Design & Development Studio

> Straya Studio is a selective, founder-led technical studio that takes
on 2–3 projects at a time. We deliver custom web design, web
development, and graphic design across Framer, Webflow, Shopify, Wix,
and WordPress for tech founders, startups, and growth-stage businesses
in the US, Canada, UK, Europe, and Australia.

## What We Do
- **Web Design:** Custom responsive layouts, wireframes, creative
  direction, brand-led visual design. No templates, ever.
- **Web Development:** Production builds on Framer, Webflow, Shopify,
  Wix, and WordPress. CMS architecture, custom interactions, 90+
  Lighthouse performance.
- **Graphic Design:** Social media kits, pitch decks, brand assets,
  marketing collateral, ad creatives, and presentation design.

## Platform Expertise
- **Framer:** Site builds, CMS, custom React components, plugin
  development, animations, responsivity, migration, and deployment.
- **Webflow:** Site builds, CMS architecture, Ecommerce, interactions,
  automation (Make.com/Zapier), memberships, SEO, and migration.
- **Shopify:** Full store builds, theme customization, Liquid
  engineering, app integration, checkout optimization, and headless.
- **Wix:** Custom builds, Velo development, CMS setup, e-commerce,
  and migration from other platforms.
- **WordPress:** Custom themes, Elementor, ACF, WooCommerce, page
  speed, security hardening, migration, and Gutenberg blocks.

## How We Work
- **Project-based only.** No retainers, no subscriptions. Every
  engagement is scoped, quoted, and delivered as a complete project.
- **3 tiers:** Starter ($2,000–$4,000) · Growth ($4,000–$9,500) ·
  Premium ($9,500–$25,000+)
- **Direct access.** You work with the founder — no account managers,
  no ticket queues.
- **Fast delivery.** Most projects ship in 1–4 weeks.
